name: What-if (hypothetical, for the demo): twelve storeys with the full funder data supplied
proponent: City of Vancouver (Non-Market Housing Development and Operations) with BC Housing; operator BC Indigenous Housing Society
rezoning_path: False Creek North ODP and CD-1 amendments approved after the 13 Jul 2023 public hearing; development permit through the SHORT program
land_tenure_plan: City-owned; 60-year lease at nominal rent to the BC Indigenous Housing Society (assumed for this what-if; not confirmed)
notes: Hypothetical option written to show the engine reacting on a CD-1 site: a 12-storey, 120-unit version of the tower with a stated bedroom mix (40% two-bed-plus, 10% three-bed-plus), a 30/50/20 rent-tier split, 30% of units below HILs, a 60-year housing agreement, 6 accessible units, 43 replacement trees to meet Schedule C on the paved lot, and a stated land tenure. None of these figures come from the City, BC Housing or the operator.
